items.title: Updates to Shard List
items.summary: Hey Zenitheans, As we look towards a more sustainable vision for Zenith, we’ve reviewed the number of shards currently online. We found a handful of shards go unused in comparison to others, and have decided to retire these shards during the release of Season 4 in August 2024 (release window TBA). Reminder: Accounts and characters aren’t locked to any shard or region, so no progress or data will be lost. We hope this will help consolidate players across the shards and make the experience better for everyone!
